alternatives.reason: Restarting propellant production also serves a goal, but I chose to replenish the core's cold-transfer reserve first.

reaction: Recharging the packs was a straightforward, reassuring step.
reason: The plant restart controls are the only remaining combination, and restoring production is the remaining goal.

effect: The return plant is running, completing the propellant production goal and the chapter.
reaction: The restart was straightforward; I was curious how the plant would replace the lost propellant, but the result did not elaborate.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reconditioning the flight packs was the most worthwhile action because it restored the cold-transfer reserve for the discovery case.

leastWorthwhile.text: Restarting the plant felt thin: the action completed the goal without showing how production resumed or replaced the boil-off.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; both actions had the expected results.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: each connected a resource to equipment named in a goal, though the plant restart offered little detail.

continue.text: I would continue to learn what happens to the frozen discovery and its journey to Earth, although this chapter's two straightforward actions gave me little new to explore.
